description: Per-platform call deep-link URL patterns. Placeholder {id} is replaced with the platform call identifier when present (Retreaver: UUID = Calyx external_call_id). Patterns without {id} are report-level vendor entry points (Ringba has no per-call URL). Override via NEXT_PUBLIC_*_CALL_URL_PATTERN env vars on the web app.

retreaver.notes: Case A confirmed: Call Log list shows truncated UUID; detail/URL use full UUID = Calyx external_call_id. Search must accept exact + prefix. Deep link https://retreaver.com/calls/{id}.

ringba.notes: Case A: inboundCallId = Calyx external_call_id (two-way search confirmed). Ringba has NO per-call URL — app.ringba.com/#/call/{id} redirects to the dashboard. Calls open inside the Call Logs report table (#/dashboard/call-logs/report/new); no documented query param to pre-filter by inboundCallId. UI: 'Open in Ringba' copies inboundCallId to clipboard, opens the report page, and toasts paste instructions (Reporting +Filter → Inbound Call ID).
